floors.label: Sentry level (z about -574): Tranquility portal, Dresolik tower base
Middle levels (z about -480 to -430): lava runes
Top of the central hall (z about 0)

mobs.name: Zone-in (safe point)
mobs.note: eqemu_zone safe point, the bottom of the tower. The Plane of Tranquility portal drops you at this zone's entry.

mobs.name: Solusek Ro
mobs.note: Level 80. Needs all five wings done to be useful: only then does his projection give the flag. The six Guardians of Fire in his chamber corridor (L73) are the trash in front of him.

links.label: script: pulls Guardians of Fire if he is dragged low

mobs.name: Xuzl
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.note: Xuzl's wing. On death a flaming cauldron and three warders appear.

mobs.name: Arlyxir
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.note: While engaged he heals to full and casts Searing Flames every 12.5 min (750 s).

mobs.name: Jiva
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.note: While engaged an efreeti add spawns every 45 s (8 different ones in a cycle).

mobs.name: Rizlona
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.note: The first Rizlona (human form, L70). Where she falls the second form (#Rizlona, dragon, 600k) stands up; that one's death leaves the cauldron.

mobs.name: Galremos
mobs.note: Named magmin (L63). Breaks into smaller pieces: magmites spawn at 90/60/35/20/5% HP (1, 2, 1, 4, 6).

mobs.name: Ra`Shalis
mobs.note: Named efreeti-type guard (L67) in the lowest cavern, next to So`Valiz.

mobs.name: So`Valiz
mobs.note: Named efreeti-type guard (L68) in the lowest cavern, next to Ra`Shalis.

mobs.name: Guardians of Dresolik (x4)
mobs.note: Four Guardians (L68, 285k) stand together; when one spawns the script restarts the other three's timers so all four are up. Killing the LAST one summons The Protector of Dresolik.

links.label: script: Protector when the last one dies

mobs.name: Guardians of Fire (x6)
mobs.note: Six L73 guardians in the corridor to Solusek Ro (the "clear the Guardians first" trash). Respawn 19.5 min.

links.label: script: pulled to Solusek if he is hurt low

mobs.name: Named demons (one of seven at each point)
mobs.note: Seven spawn points in Dresolik's tower share one spawn group: each respawn picks one of Balrezu, Grezou, Instadis, Naelizar, Quazlith, Veleroth, Zrexul (about 14-15% each). All L70.

mobs.name: a pumice collector (rare)
mobs.note: Rare spawn: about 3% chance in place of the usual mob at 8 spawn points.

mobs.name: a sweltering mephit (rare)
mobs.note: Rare spawn: about 3% chance in place of the usual mob at 57 spawn points.

mobs.name: a fervid magmin (rare)
mobs.note: Rare spawn: about 3% chance in place of the usual mob at 3 spawn points.

mobs.name: a flare mephit (rare)
mobs.note: Rare spawn: about 3% chance in place of the usual mob at 16 spawn points.

mobs.name: a radiant guardian (rare)
mobs.note: Rare spawn: about 3% chance in place of the usual mob at 25 spawn points.

mobs.name: a runed giant (rare)
mobs.note: Rare spawn: about 3% chance in place of the usual mob at 9 spawn points.

mobs.name: The Protector of Dresolik
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.trigger: Spawns (unique_spawn) when the last of the four Guardians of Dresolik dies and no other Guardian is up. Depops after 2.5 hours; while engaged it is leashed to 558 < x < 978.

links.label: script: spawn on last Guardian death (spawn L12)

mobs.name: Rizlona, second form (#Rizlona)
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.trigger: Spawns where the first Rizlona dies (anywhere inside her room, y 2047..2538; the point drawn is her catalog spawn point). Leashes back to (-1103, 2384) outside y 2047..2538. Depops after 2.5 hours.

links.label: script: spawn at her death spot (L2)

mobs.name: A Planar Projection
mobs.trigger: Spawns when Solusek Ro dies (Planar Projection, only claimable by the raid/group that made the kill). Hail it with all five wing flags (sol_room 11111) for the flag. Depops after 20 minutes. While it is up the two floor doors in his chamber open.

mobs.name: Xuzl's flaming cauldron
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.trigger: Spawns when Xuzl dies. Stays 30 minutes (paused while engaged). Everyone clicks the cauldron door (door 12, 1835.8, -314.8, 336) for their own wing flag (digit 1 of sol_room); clicked while it is not up you only become disoriented.

mobs.name: Warders of Xuzl (x3)
mobs.trigger: Three warders spawn with the cauldron when Xuzl dies (L1, 23600 hp, pulled but not a boss). Depop after 1 hour.

links.label: script: 1 hour depop (all five warder scripts are identical)

mobs.name: Arlyxir's flaming cauldron
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.trigger: Spawns when Arlyxir dies. Stays 30 minutes (paused while engaged). Everyone clicks the cauldron door (door 7, 1570.6, 1944.3, 624) for their own wing flag (digit 2 of sol_room); clicked while it is not up you only become disoriented.

mobs.name: Warders of Arlyxir (x3)
mobs.trigger: Three warders spawn with the cauldron when Arlyxir dies (L1, 23600 hp, pulled but not a boss). Depop after 1 hour.

links.label: script: 1 hour depop (all five warder scripts are identical)

mobs.name: Dresolik's flaming cauldron
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.trigger: Spawns when The Protector of Dresolik dies. Stays 30 minutes (paused while engaged). Everyone clicks the cauldron door (door 10, 215.7, 1478.7, -72) for their own wing flag (digit 3 of sol_room); clicked while it is not up you only become disoriented.

mobs.name: Warders of Dresolik (x3)
mobs.trigger: Three warders spawn with the cauldron when The Protector of Dresolik dies (L1, 23600 hp, pulled but not a boss). Depop after 1 hour.

links.label: script: 1 hour depop (all five warder scripts are identical)

mobs.name: Rizlona's flaming cauldron
mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis
mobs.trigger: Spawns when the second Rizlona dies. Stays 30 minutes (paused while engaged). Everyone clicks the cauldron door (door 6, -943.8, 2663.9, -912) for their own wing flag (digit 4 of sol_room); clicked while it is not up you only become disoriented.

mobs.name: Warders of Rizlona (x3)
mobs.trigger: Three warders spawn with the cauldron when the second Rizlona dies (L1, 23600 hp, pulled but not a boss). Depop after 1 hour.

links.label: script: 1 hour depop (all five warder scripts are identical)

mobs.checklist: The five Tower of Solusek Ro minis

mobs.name: Jiva's efreeti adds (one every 45 s)
mobs.trigger: While Jiva is engaged, every 45 s one of eight named efreeti (Makin, Adeel, Jiri, Seif, Nabil, Aydin, Cemal, Fahim; L68, 30-35k) spawns at the next ring point and Jiva calls for it. The cycle restarts at each pull. Each depops after 10 minutes out of combat.

links.label: script: add types and ring points

mobs.name: Magmites (Galremos splits)
mobs.trigger: Galremos breaks apart at 90, 60, 35, 20 and 5% HP and spawns 1, 2, 1, 4 and 6 magmites (L60) at the spot where he stands (his catalog spawn point is the point drawn).
